verdicts.title: Quantified boolean formula problem
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This paper is devoted to the complexity of the quantified boolean formula problem. We describe a simple deterministic algorithm that, for a given quantified boolean formula $F$, stops in time bounded by $O(|F|^4)$ and answers yes if $F$ is true and no otherwise.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes a deterministic algorithm for the QBF problem with O(|F|^4) runtime, making no mention of Galois groups, GF(2), or clause-count bounds on algebraic invariants. It shares only the general SAT/Boolean formula vocabulary with the conjecture.
